about: Silhouette design page presets ("Start from"). settings are applied over the page's defaults; fields name the extra setting groups shown; rules are handled in silhouette.js: tab_thickness (thickness follows the lamp tab), layers (spread positions near side first; a viewpoint with detected ridges sets the count), distance_thickness (Thicker when closer starts on for a viewpoint source), caption (filled from the route).

custom.name: Custom
custom.summary: One piece with your own caption and mount.

glow-edge.name: Edge-lit ridgeline
glow-edge.summary: One clear panel the lamp's slot thickness; the engraved caption catches the edge light.
glow-edge.hint: Print in clear or translucent PETG at 100 % infill and 0.12 mm layers, front face up.

glow-stencil.name: Stencil lamp
glow-stencil.summary: An opaque 3 mm piece with a large cut-through caption the light shines through.
glow-stencil.hint: Print in an opaque color; the lamp lights the letters and the ridgeline's edge.

glow-layers.name: Layered glow
glow-layers.summary: Thin panels from several slices stand in a comb base that drops into the lamp; rear ridges rise above front ones.
glow-layers.hint: For a real view, pick a viewpoint on the geography page with Beyond and Detect ridges set: each ridge becomes a panel, closer ones thicker. Print the panels in translucent PETG, the front panel darkest (or most opaque) and the back palest; print the comb base clear so the lamp shines up through it.

glow-clouds.name: Layered glow with clouds
glow-clouds.summary: The layered glow with a puffy cloud panel standing behind the ridges, in its own slot at the back of the comb base.
glow-clouds.hint: The clouds are decorative, not mapped terrain. Print them in white or the palest translucent filament so the lamp lights them most; the ridge panels translucent, the front darkest; the comb base clear.

glow-skyline.name: Skyline night-light
glow-skyline.summary: A slice through town with the mapped buildings standing on the ground, a stencil name, and a lamp tab.
glow-skyline.hint: Print opaque. Turn on the Buildings map layer on the geography page so the slice can include them.

box-diorama.name: Layered mountain diorama
box-diorama.summary: Layers from the near side of the frame to the far side stand in two spacer combs, each base a step higher so every ridge shows.
box-diorama.hint: For a real view, pick a viewpoint on the geography page with Beyond and Detect ridges set: each ridge becomes a layer, closer ones thicker. Print each layer in its own color, palest at the back, darkest at the front. Measure the box's inside.

box-trail.name: Trail memory box
box-trail.summary: The uploaded route's elevation along its length, a slot for a photo or map behind it, and a pin hole at the summit for a brass nail marker.
box-trail.hint: Without an uploaded route it uses the slice. The 1.8 mm summit hole fits the bundled nail marker's nail.

box-chart.name: Elevation chart box
box-chart.summary: The route's profile with its distance, climb, and date as a caption and distance ticks along the base.
box-chart.hint: Ticks follow the ft / m switch: every mile or every kilometer.

box-anniversary.name: Anniversary box
box-anniversary.summary: A stencil caption of names and a date, with a photo slot behind one layer at the chosen slice.
box-anniversary.hint: Light or a photo behind the piece shows through the cut-out letters.

flat-zones.name: Ridgeline color zones
flat-zones.summary: One flat piece in up to four colors: each ridge seen from the viewpoint is its own color zone, nearer ridges darker and thicker so the piece steps toward you.
flat-zones.hint: Pick a viewpoint on the geography page with Beyond and Detect ridges set. Print front face up on a four-filament printer: assign each 3MF color part its filament; the caption shares the farthest color.

race.name: Running or cycling race profile
race.summary: The race's elevation along its length with distance ticks, START and FINISH, a caption with your finish time, and pegs to hang medals.
race.hint: Running ticks every mile or kilometer, cycling every ten. Pegs stand out of the front face; print front face up.
